pages.text: Every biome holds unique species:$(br)$(br)• $(l)Desert$(): Sand Gliders & Pharaoh Bass.$(br)• $(l)Ice$(): Glacier Perch & Absolute Zero.$(br)• $(l)Jungle$(): Piranha Kings & Canopy Spirits.$(br)• $(l)Swamp & Mushroom$(): Toxic & Mycelium fish.
$(l)Rarity & Value$()$(br)$(br)The rarer and cooler the fish, the harder the fishing minigame will be. But the reward is worth it — top-tier market prices!
